capabilities: create and edit spreadsheet files in the vault
embed selected cell ranges in Markdown via embed links
disambiguation: Not a Microsoft Excel integration; it renders sheets with the x-spreadsheet library and only imports or exports xlsx files.
extras: The README opens with a deprecation notice directing users to the successor plugin Obsidian-Sheet-Plus; it also notes that xlsx files created with Microsoft Office 365 may need special handling on import, and links to docs/images that were stripped from this text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create spreadsheets or embed editable sheet data inside notes.

relations.evidence: integrates x-spreadsheet, a feature sheet tool, into Obsidian
The Obsidian-Excel plugin will no longer be maintained or updated

summary: Spreadsheet editor built on x-spreadsheet that stores and edits sheet files in the vault and embeds cell ranges in Markdown.
